heading: Calendars
intro: Import a calendar to see busy time alongside your plan. Your calendar stays on this device.
noSources: No calendars yet. Import an .ics file or add a subscription.
noEvents: Create an event to add it to your preferred calendar.
title: Title
formInvalid: Enter a title, valid date/time, positive duration, and valid attendee emails (up to 50).
size: This calendar exceeds the 5 MB limit.
frequency: Secondly and minutely recurrence rules are not supported.
timezone: This calendar uses an unknown time zone. Export it with a VTIMEZONE definition.
iterations: This calendar exceeds the 50,000-iteration limit for this range.
occurrences: This calendar exceeds the 5,000-event limit for this range.
invalid: This calendar could not be read. Choose a valid .ics file.
range: Choose an end after the start of the range.
interval: This calendar contains an event ending before it starts.
storage: Calendar storage is unavailable. Check browser storage permissions and try again.
save: Changes could not be saved. Your previous data has been retained.
missing: The calendar source text is missing. Import the file again or refresh its subscription.
url: Enter an http, https or webcal URL without a username or password.
fetch: This feed could not be fetched (CORS or network error). Google, Outlook and iCloud private feeds usually block browser access. Use Import .ics file, or open Next168 in companion mode and try again.
